articles.summary: * Duffel’s platform is now powering travel experiences at the heart of Robinhood’s Banking platform, bringing flights, hotels and car hire directly inside the app * Robinhood Platinum Cardholders earn 10% cash back on hotels and car rentals, and 5% cash back on flights when booking via Robinhood’s travel portal, alongside hotel and travel credit and unlimited lounge access * Robinhood joins a growing roster of brands, including Bilt and Rippling, turning to Duffel to help unlock the revenue,
articles.title: Robinhood taps Duffel to power travel rewards for its Platinum and Gold Cardholders
